title: Relative LOS motion · fitted multi-date rate
notes: All plotted regional comparisons use the same pixels valid on every selected date or pair. Per-date coverage is shown separately; missing coverage is never reported as zero change.
Conversion is −λ × (phase − reference median)/(4π), in millimeters. Check product sign convention before assigning toward/away language.
Only the retained native connected component is used. Read the correction manifest: ionospheric subtraction is optional; tropospheric and tidal corrections are not assumed.
Reference stability is an assumption. No vertical motion, structural safety, failure probability or thaw depth is inferred.
Mixed processing revisions were explicitly accepted. Algorithm differences may mimic surface change. Compare a single-revision run; release families and viewing geometries remain separate.
Rate maps fit a trend across reconstructed acquired epochs. The dated timeline shows accumulated relative LOS changes in cm, not separate pair intervals. Original pair maps remain available.
cm/year is annualized from the selected record; cm/month = cm/year / 12. Positive means toward the satellite, negative away. Neither is automatically vertical sinking.

A connected tree can be reconstructed but has no independent closure check: a zero pair residual is then guaranteed by the model and is not evidence of accuracy. Fit residual, phase errors and reference assumptions must be inspected.
Input is a local native-grid area extract, not a complete original NASA product; only the saved rectangle can be analyzed.
Only native connected component 1 retained before averaging. Labels are file-local; see the correction manifest for any explicitly applied screen.

los_model.method: Connected chronological pair incidence least squares; first acquisition fixed to zero; intercept + linear trend at acquired epochs, 365.25 days/year.
los_model.closure_interpretation: Connected tree: zero pair residual is expected by construction; no independent closure check exists.
los_model.interpretation: Positive is toward the satellite, negative away. Relative to the chosen reference, not vertical subsidence. Annualized short-window trends do not measure a full year. Fit residual is internal consistency, not accuracy or a confidence interval.

report.headline: What these observations show
findings: 6 compatible GUNW observations cover 2025-10-25 to 2026-01-17. Regional comparisons use 510,464 common analysis cells (3266.970 km²).

Reference uses 2698 identical cells across pairs. Pair network: 7 epochs, 1 connected component(s), 0 redundant edge(s). Read the P04 motion-model status or the other phase tools’ network-model status to see whether reconstruction was supported.
Fitted relative LOS rate: regional median 1.597 cm/year (0.133 cm per mean month), using 7 acquired dates over 84.000 days. Rates are relative to the saved reference, not vertical subsidence.
The dated reconstruction is model-derived from measured pairs. No motion is interpolated between acquisitions. Zero pair residuals in a tree do not validate the result.
report.comparison_basis: fixed common footprint across all selected observations
next_checks: Inspect observation counts and source quality before interpreting a pattern.
Compare the map and observed dates; blank pixels are missing evidence.
Use independent observations to test environmental attribution.
report.validation: Synthetic engineering tests check known calculations and missing-data behavior; independent real-world accuracy is not established.

reading_guide.measurement: A fitted rate of relative line-of-sight (LOS) movement from connected acquisition-date estimates.
reading_guide.colours: Positive LOS is toward the satellite; negative is away, relative to the chosen reference. cm/year and cm/month express the same fitted rate; annualizing a short record does not create a year of observations.
reading_guide.checks: Check the shared reference support and its independent physical stability, record span, coherence, fit residuals and network redundancy. A tree has no redundant closure test; a zero pair residual can occur by construction.
reading_guide.cannot: One viewing direction mixes horizontal and vertical motion. This is not a direct vertical subsidence rate, a guaranteed forecast or independently established geodetic accuracy.
reading_guide.validation: Source checksums verify input integrity. Replay checks verify reproducibility. Neither establishes independent environmental accuracy for this run.
